title: Better support for binaries, on Linux
description:
In particular, we put the locally built binary packages
in completely separate repos, and only add these repos
to the repo list if binaries are considered.

They are used by default for install_packages() and
update_packages(), but not for download_packages() and
available_packages().

Fixes #21.

title: Metadata caching
description:
* there is a five minutes cache
* it performs a HEAD request first
* downloads are performed in parallel
* it always downloads PACKAGES.gz files for now
* converts PACKAGES.gz to RDS
* sneaks the RDS file(s) into tempdir() for available.packages to use.
* filtered package list is cached as well
